ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.title: Dialogue
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.gate: Halt. The gate closes at dusk, and dusk was an hour ago. State your business, traveller.
I bring rice for the storehouse.
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.rice: At this hour? The quartermaster sleeps, and so should you. Fine. Leave the cart by the wall, and keep your hands where I can see them.
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.pass: Then pass through somewhere else. This road belongs to the lord after dark.
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.lant: Hm? Gods, so it has. The sergeant will have my hide.
I could hold the gate while you light it.
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.help: Kind of you. Don't touch anything. I'll be right back.
ui.emergentstealth.dialogue.preview.wait: Good. Don't move. I'll only be a moment.
commands.emergentstealth.dev.dialogue.un: That client doesn't have Emergent Stealth, so it can't show the preview.
